Privacy notice

How Daily Letter uses your information

When you create a Player ID, Daily Letter stores the information you enter: your name, username, age, phone number, street address, city, state, ZIP code, and a securely hashed version of your password.

Why it is collected

The information is used to create and maintain your player account, let you sign in, save game results, calculate participation statistics, and support the game service.

Security

Passwords are transformed using a one-way password hash before storage. Login sessions use secure, HttpOnly cookies. Access to the administrator dashboard requires a separate private password.

Your choices

Do not create an account if you do not agree to this collection. To request access, correction, or deletion, contact the site owner using the contact method provided by Daily Letter.

Important: The site owner must add a working privacy-contact method here before promoting the game publicly.
